title: Four gliding beings in uniforms beside the truck
place_text: November-5 launch facility, near Nisland, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I turn my head and I see these four I'm going to call them beings and they are not walking as you and I walk they are just gliding across the ground
And as they approached me, there was three small ones and one tall one in the back.
tellings.difference: Says three were small and one tall one was at the back.
tellings.link_reason: The same four gliding beings coming toward the truck at November 5.

as_told.title: Four gliding beings come toward the truck
as_told.place_text: November 5 missile site, Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I think I remember small figures, maybe five or six, walking toward the vehicle. Standing behind them was a taller figure who I think was in charge.

plain: In 1977, at a nuclear missile site called November-5 near Nisland, South Dakota, a young Air Force security guard says he turned and saw four beings coming toward his truck, and they were not walking but gliding over the ground. The guard is Mario Woods, who tells Michels he was there. "They are not walking as you and I walk, they are just gliding across the ground," he says. In a later conversation he gives the group as three small ones with one tall one at the back. Woods had already written the story down for the journalist Robert Hastings, who published it on 10 September 2017 under the title "Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site", an ICBM being a long-range nuclear missile. In that text Woods is less sure: "I think I remember small figures, maybe five or six, walking toward the vehicle," with "a taller figure who I think was in charge" standing behind them. So the 2017 account gives a different number and has them walking, and it hedges the memory. Every version agrees on a tall leader behind smaller figures. If it happened, it would mean strange beings walked right up to a guard at an American nuclear weapons site.

discussion.by: Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site
discussion.text: In the account Woods wrote for Hastings in 2017 he thinks he remembers "small figures, maybe five or six, walking toward the vehicle" with "a taller figure who I think was in charge" behind them; the later telling has three small beings and a tall one, gliding. The count and the gait differ, and the 2017 text holds the memory with Woods's own hedges.
